$comment: Only 'repos' is required. Everything else has a default; the values below are the defaults,
shown so you can see what you are changing.

workspaceFiles.$comment: Per-repo overrides, for monorepos where the pnpm settings are not at the root.

$comment_commit: Identity for the commits the prune makes. Required before the prune will push: commits need
an author, and guessing one would attribute automated changes to whoever happens to be
$comment_checks: Every check is on by default. A missing lockfile skips the maintenance check.
Strict merge rules do not skip default-branch inspection.
